matches.title: EduSchedule — Academic Timetabling & Room Booking Platform
matches.snippet: Web-based platform for automated class timetabling, exam scheduling, and room/resource booking across multiple campuses. Includes conflict detection and space-utilisation reporting.

matches.title: MedConnect — Patient Portal & Appointment Booking
